note: The graph steps fail if graph draws an unheld group under holdings (the group path in graph.rs) instead of refusing it, or focuses a node for a group in reference. The variable steps fail if a held variable whose group member rows are all unheld names that group under holdings, in show (sending the webapp to a group page with no lane for it), schema or graph (group_key or schema's group column ignoring member_in_scope). The search steps fail if a holdings search folds the two held variables, whose group member rows are all unheld, into the group hit (fold ignoring member_in_scope) instead of returning both variables, if the group label hit ignores scope, or if the reference twin stops returning the group.
